name: emaus-barbearia
description: Sistema de Gestão e Agendamento EMAUS Barbearia

scripts.dev:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.local.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-emaus-local "node server/scripts/local-emulator.js"
scripts.test:local: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.local.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-emaus-local "node server/scripts/local-emulator.js --smoke"
scripts.test: node --test server/tests/crm-utils.test.js server/tests/monthly-booking.test.js server/tests/ui-safe.test.js server/tests/booking-pricing.test.js && node server/test_validacao_antecedencia.js && node server/test_pix_webhook_logic.js && node server/test_whatsapp_bot_suite.js
scripts.test:syntax: node server/tests/check-html-scripts.js && node --check server/src/server.js && node --check server/scripts/set-admin-claim.js && node --check server/scripts/migrate-slots-privacy.js && node --check server/scripts/sync-monthly-crm.js
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-emaus-barbearia "node --test server/tests/firestore.rules.test.js server/tests/monthly-booking.emulator.test.js server/tests/booking-pricing.emulator.test.js server/tests/booking-benefits.emulator.test.js server/tests/booking-benefits-payment.emulator.test.js server/tests/free-booking.emulator.test.js server/tests/manual-booking.emulator.test.js server/tests/single-booking.emulator.test.js server/tests/crm-auth.emulator.test.js server/tests/business-logic-diagnostic.emulator.test.js server/tests/monthly-identity-link.emulator.test.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:syntax && npm test && npm run test:firebase
